blurb: The Indian trick-taking game for two partnerships: bid 16 to 28, pick a hidden trump, take the points.
description: Four players in two partnerships. Bid for your side on four cards, lay the trump aside face down, then play eight tricks: J, 9, A and 10 carry the 28 points. Ask for the trump when you can't follow suit. The pair rule is an option. Bots fill empty seats.
author: lokeshmohanty
